lines.en: Do you realize that four weeks from today we're getting married?
Do you realize that you get louder each week?
There's still so much to do.
Have you written your vows yet?
I figured I'd just buy those.
Pat, I'd like to buy a vow.
Sweetie, you know I have no sense of humor when it comes to the wedding.
Right. So, have you written yours yet?
No, but I know exactly what I'm going to say.
Do you happen to know exactly what I'm going to say?
All right. Let's just do it right now, okay?
It won't be hard. Just say what's in your heart.
Look at her go. She must love me more than I love her.
